verdict.line: You lose if Death's Grasp (E) drags you in while his Darkness Rise passive is armed and he lands a full Obliterate (Q); you win if you dodge the pull, bait his Q on cooldown, and force the fight into a Counter Strike (E) stun.

brief.thesis: This is a 53.4% win rate over 133 games for Jax despite an even lane shape, because Mordekaiser's threat is front-loaded into Obliterate (Q) poke and the Death's Grasp (E) pull, while Jax's Counter Strike (E) stun and Relentless Assault (R) attack-speed stacking win any fight that goes long. Solo-kill advantage sits with Jax specifically because Counter Strike punishes him for committing to melee range to finish a trade.

theirWindow.what: Once pulled in, he gets a free, close-range Obliterate (Q) and is one landed hit from arming Darkness Rise (3 attacks/spells triggers his damage aura and move speed). Back off and let the shove happen rather than trading through it.

yourWindow.what: Q sits at 8/7/6/5/4s cooldown and is his only reliable poke/engage tool at range. When it's down, walk up and trade with Leap Strike (Q) into Empower (W); if he tries to melee back, Counter Strike (E) stuns him and everything around you for free damage.

start.why: The higher-sample start (52.8% wr, 64.4% pick) — the extra AD and sustain matter more here than the shield, since your wins come from all-in trades, not soaking poke.

boots.why: Standard pick (47.9% wr, 65% pick) — Mordekaiser's entire kit is magic damage, so the MR directly reduces the Obliterate (Q) hits and Realm of Death (R) burst you're trying to survive.

core.why: The single biggest power spike in the matchup — its proc damage stacks with Empower (W) and Relentless Assault (R) to let you out-trade his short-cooldown Q.
Rewards landing Counter Strike (E) into an auto with bonus damage and a shield, which is exactly the punish window this matchup is built around.
The best-sampled third item (76.9% wr, 13 games) — lets you survive a Realm of Death (R) isolation or a Death's Grasp (E) pull gone wrong.

situational.when: he's outscaling you in extended fights off Indestructible (W) shield stacking
you need to survive burst from his Realm of Death (R) all-in and fight back through it
he's building tanky and you need current-health damage to punish his sustain
the game goes long and you need a stat-check item to keep pace with his late scaling

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-pick build (34.5% pick, 46.3% wr) — ramping attack speed rewards the extended trades Jax wins in this matchup, especially once a Counter Strike (E) stun lets you land free autos into a fight his Q poke can't outpace.

summoners.why: The most-run and best-performing combo (53.3% wr, 78.4% pick). Ignite matters specifically here because Indestructible (W) lets him bank damage into a self-heal — the grievous wounds cut that heal down and turn your all-ins into real kills.

playing.title: Track his passive stack count
playing.detail: Darkness Rise arms after 3 landed attacks or spells on you and gives him a damage aura plus move speed. If it's up, disengage rather than trade — you're fighting a buffed version of him.

playing.title: Don't stand alone for Obliterate
playing.detail: Q deals more damage to a single target than when it hits multiple enemies, so stay near minions when he's in range rather than giving him a clean isolated hit.

playing.title: Respect the pull, then punish it
playing.detail: Death's Grasp (E) is his only hard engage/peel tool at 700 range. Dodge it with Leap Strike (Q) positioning when possible — once it's spent on cooldown (16 down to 8s), he has no way to stop you from walking away or diving in.

playing.title: Save Counter Strike for his commitment
playing.detail: He rarely trades with autos, so don't burn E early to dodge attacks — hold it until he walks in after a Q or E, then stun him and anyone else nearby for the follow-up.

playing.title: All-in once Trinity Force is up
playing.detail: Once Trinity Force and Sundered Sky are both online, Relentless Assault's (R) attack speed stacking plus Empower (W) burst wins any extended fight his short Q cooldown can't keep pace with.

playing.title: Track his ultimate cooldown
playing.detail: Realm of Death sits at 140/120/100/90/80s. It's not up most of the early game post-6, but once it cycles back, overextending gets you isolated and stat-drained if he kills you in it.

playing.title: Use Ignite to close out fights
playing.detail: Indestructible (W) turns his all-in damage into a heal. Popping Ignite before he consumes the shield denies most of that sustain and converts an even trade into a kill.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, and summoner picks are pulled from measured Jax vs. Mordekaiser games on the current patch (133-game sample for the head-to-head win rate); the power-curve timing and trade reasoning are my own read of both kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being pulled by Death’s Grasp(E). Retreat if Mordekaiser’s passive ability activates.
